1. Buy a beat-up house below market
2. Rehab it
3. Rent it out
4. Refinance: the bank appraises the fixed-up house and lends you most of its new value
5. Repeat with the same cash

Buy a house. Get your cash back. The BRRRR method, made simple.

Buy a beat-up house below market. Rehab it. Rent it out. Refinance: the bank appraises the fixed-up house and lends you a share of its new value. Repeat with the same money.

Example: buy for $150K, put $40K into it, appraise at $260K, and a 75% refinance returns $195K. That covers what went in, before closing costs.

The catch: the after-repair value has to be real. Overpay or overspend, and your cash stays stuck. Lender seasoning rules, rates and closing costs all change the math.
